name: comp-460

frames.best_why: Full visible run of first and back chevrons, pages 1 to 4 with 3 active, and the ellipsis.
frames.render_note: Next and Last chevrons fall outside the crop; only First, Previous, the numbers and ellipsis show.

tagline: Numbered pages led by jump-to-first and step-back chevrons.
summary: A flat numbered pager with first-page and previous chevrons before the page links, an ellipsis for skipped pages, and next and last chevrons after them in the code.
appearance: A flat row on black opens with a bar-and-chevron first glyph and a single back chevron, then pages 1 to 4 with 3 in a rounded grey box, then a three-dot ellipsis. The right-hand next and last glyphs sit outside the recorded crop.
behaviour: Hovering a chevron or number lays a darker rounded fill behind it while the active page keeps its grey block. The demo's page never advances, so only the hover fills change.
demo_content: Page numbers 1 to 4 with page 3 active.
search_phrases: pagination with first and last buttons
jump to the first page arrow
skip to start or end of list
go back to page one quickly
last page shortcut in a pager
use_when: Long lists where people want to jump to the very start or end as well as step through pages.
avoid_when: When the row must fit a narrow column: the icon-heavy pager needs a wide container.
customise: Pass currentPage, totalPages and the number of page slots; chevron icons, their order and styling are fixed in the file.
weight_why: A short row of page links and chevrons; only hover and active styling.

a11y.note: Every chevron has an aria-label including first and last, so names are clear; the hover fills have no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The recorded crop cuts off the Next and Last chevrons, showing only the left half of the pager.
polish_why: Clean numbered pager with clear chevrons, but the cropped right side makes it look unfinished.
title: Pagination First Last
